# Upstream Ice issues and their status in Icey

This page maps bugs reported against [Ice](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice) (jordanbaird/Ice) to their status in Icey. If you hit one of these in Ice, [install Icey](../README.md#install) instead. Icey replaces Ice and keeps your settings.

Each fix is described in the [release](https://github.com/leonardovida/icey/releases) that ships it, and on [Icey's website](https://leonardovida.github.io/icey/fixes/). Issue titles are quoted as they appear upstream. To report a problem that isn't listed, [open an issue in Icey](https://github.com/leonardovida/icey/issues/new/choose).

## Partly addressed

These have a fix that couldn't be confirmed yet, or that covers part of the report.

| Upstream issue | Problem | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [#1004](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/1004) | Ice keeps asking for a permission that is already enabled | Icey explains what to do: remove the app from the list in System Settings with the minus button, then add it again. Screen Recording granted while Icey runs now takes effect without a relaunch. |
| [#929](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/929) | Menu bar icons are scaled wrong on external displays | Item images now use the scale of the display they were captured on. Not yet confirmed on a two-display setup. |
| [#987](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/987) | Ice Bar icons shrink on an external display | Item images now take their scale from the capture itself. Not yet confirmed on a two-display setup. |
| [#955](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/955) | Ice Bar icons are scaled wrong on another display | Item images now take their scale from the capture itself. Not yet confirmed on a two-display setup. |
| [#910](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/910) | The menu bar tint shows on the wrong display with an iPad as a second screen | An appearance overlay that ends up on another display now hides itself. Not yet confirmed with an iPad. |
| [#908](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/908) | System freeze after long uptime with Ice running | The crashing code from Ice 0.11.12 is gone. Retries now back off and stop after five rounds, and Icey recovers when its divider reappears. The freeze itself hasn't been reproduced. |

## Not a bug in Ice or Icey

| Upstream issue | Title | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| [#930](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/930) | Removed icon from tray and can't get it back | Turn the icon back on in System Settings > Menu Bar. |
| [#934](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/934) | Nothing happens when I try to run Ice | Ice is running but its icon has no room in the menu bar, for example next to the notch. It shows up on a wider display. Hide or remove other items, or reduce item spacing. |
| [#906](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/906) | App opens in dock when expanding the bar | This is how "Hide application menus" works: it makes the app active for a moment. Turn that setting off, or use the Ice Bar. |
| [#974](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/974) | Orphaned application menu-bar windows stuck at CGWindow layer 101, invisible to accessibility | Not caused by Ice: the reporter saw it with the setting off and after removing Ice. |
| [#909](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/909) | OneDrive icons | Some apps don't remember their item positions, so macOS places them in the always-hidden section. See the frequent issues page. |
| [#915](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/915) | Unsplash client crashes shortly after being hidden by ICE | The other app crashes when its item is off screen. See the frequent issues page. |
| [#949](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/949) | How to uninstall? | See the frequent issues page. |
| [#1015](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/1015) | Is the project still alive? | Ice is no longer maintained. Icey continues it. |
| [#993](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/993) | This project is no longer maintained by the original author | Ice is no longer maintained. Icey continues it. |
| [#939](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/939) | IS THIS PROJECT ABANDONED? | Ice is no longer maintained. Icey continues it. |
| [#1011](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/1011) | Some Golden Gate Clarity | Ice is no longer maintained. Icey continues it, with early macOS 27 support. |
| [#966](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/966) | Unofficial macOS 26-compatible build of Ice | Not a bug. |
| [#935](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/935) | Website SSL cert expired | This is about upstream's website, not the app. |

## Feature requests

| Upstream issue | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [#938](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/938) | Option that lets you choose location of new items | Not started. Needs a way to recognize new items and move them automatically. Pull requests welcome. |
| [#961](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/961) | No dock icon | Not started. Needs an option to keep Icey out of the Dock while Settings is open. Pull requests welcome. |

## Upstream pull requests included in Icey

Icey includes these community pull requests that upstream Ice has not merged. Their authors are credited in the commits.

- [#995](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/995): restore hiding, the Ice Bar and the layout editor on macOS 27.
- [#1001](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/issues/1001): follow-ups for the remaining macOS 27 gaps.
- [#953](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/953), [#950](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/950): helper connection on macOS 26 (adapted).
- [#956](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/956), [#967](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/967): crash fixes (adapted).
- [#945](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/945), [#870](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/870): update prompt fixes (adapted).
- [#928](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/928): pick up permissions granted after launch (adapted).
- [#922](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/922), [#942](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/942), [#972](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/972), [#1012](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice/pull/1012): smaller fixes.
